mapper.sql: WITH MATERIAL_ROWS AS ( SELECT B.PST_SN, B.PST_TTL, B.ETC1 AS LRN_TYPE_CD, B.ETC2 AS DATA_TYPE_CD, B.ETC3 AS PROGRAM_TYPE_CD, CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AS PROGRAM_SN, F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, F.FILE_SEQ, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM, F.REG_DT AS FILE_REG_DT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B INNER JOIN ATCH_FILE_INFO F ON F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' UNION ALL SELECT B.PST_SN, B.PST_TTL, B.ETC1 AS LRN_TYPE_CD, B.ETC2 AS DATA_TYPE_CD, B.ETC3 AS PROGRAM_TYPE_CD, CAST(NULLIF(B.ETC4, '') AS UNSIGNED) AS PROGRAM_SN, NULL AS ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, NULL AS FILE_SEQ, NULL AS ORGNL_FILE_NM, B.REG_DT AS FILE_REG_DT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B WHERE B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO ) ), DOWNLOAD_COUNTS AS ( SELECT PST_SN, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, FILE_SEQ, COUNT(*) AS DOWNLOAD_COUNT FROM EDU_LRN_MTRL_DWNLD_LOG GROUP BY PST_SN, ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO, FILE_SEQ )

FROM MATERIAL_ROWS M LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = M.PROGRAM_TYPE_CD AND P.PRGRM_SN = M.PROGRAM_SN AND P.DEL_DT IS NULL LEFT JOIN DOWNLOAD_COUNTS D ON D.PST_SN = M.PST_SN AND D.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO <=> M.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO AND D.FILE_SEQ <=> M.FILE_SEQ

choose.otherwise: AND ( P.PRGRM_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.PST_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR M.ORGNL_FILE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql: M.PST_SN, M.LRN_TYPE_CD, CASE M.LRN_TYPE_CD WHEN 'PRE' THEN '사전학습' WHEN 'MAIN' THEN '본학습' WHEN 'POST' THEN '사후학습' ELSE M.LRN_TYPE_CD END AS LRN_TYPE_NM, M.DATA_TYPE_CD, CASE M.DATA_TYPE_CD WHEN 'LINK' THEN '링크' WHEN 'DOC' THEN '문서' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '영상' ELSE M.DATA_TYPE_CD END AS DATA_TYPE_NM, COALESCE(P.PRGRM_NM, '-') AS PROGRAM_NM, M.PST_TTL AS POST_TITLE, M.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO AS ATTACHMENT_FILE_MNG_NO, M.FILE_SEQ, COALESCE(M.ORGNL_FILE_NM, '-') AS ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME, COALESCE(D.DOWNLOAD_COUNT, 0) AS DOWNLOAD_COUNT, M.FILE_REG_DT
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY M.FILE_REG_DT DESC, M.PST_SN DESC, M.FILE_SEQ ASC
